column1: # Zodiac's words for a screen reader (fm1-reader): the text sent <TAB> what to say.

column2: welcome to zodiac. octave down stops and starts. master is the volume. turn algorithm for more tips.
the star signs. each has an image and music that plays itself. after thirty minutes the next takes over.
the wheel. turn select for the wheel. rest on a sign and it opens. turn presets and it goes to the next.
a button each. f x to rec are the twelve signs, aries to pisces. the lit one is playing.
a d j's hands. knobs one to four: low pass, high pass, echo, reverb. all the way down, the piece as it is.
the bottom left button. press it and the sign answers. the ram bleats, the lion roars, the water pours.
the lower buttons. each is an effect for as long as you hold it. hold several at once.
try this. count nine along the bottom edge. hold that button. choose another sign. let go. the music winds up to speed.
save. octave up keeps the four knobs for next time.
thirty minutes. after thirty minutes of playing, the next sign takes over. like the thirty degrees each has in the sky.
leave it playing. keep it playing for as long as you like. the music changes all the time.
